title: ArchZen CLI Help & Configuration Schema
description: Strongly typed JSON Schema for CLI commands, subcommands, arguments, flags, and help objects with autocomplete support for YAML and JSON.

$schema.description: URL or relative path to the JSON Schema definition.

name.description: Name of the CLI binary or command-line tool (e.g., 'archzen').

version.description: Semantic version string of the CLI application (e.g., '1.0.0').

description.description: High-level summary or description of the CLI tool.

author.description: Author, team, or maintainer of the CLI.

global_flags.description: Global flags available across all commands in the CLI (e.g., --dev, --force).

commands.description: Dictionary of CLI commands where each entry can be a Command or a collection of subcommands.

FlagType.description: Accepted data type for flag values and command arguments.
enumDescriptions: Boolean flag switch (true or false, or presence of flag)
markdownEnumDescriptions: `Boolean`: Boolean switch (`true` / `false`, or flag presence without value).

Argument.description: Definition of a positional argument accepted by this command.

name.description: Identifier name of the positional argument (e.g., 'bootloader', 'gen_scripts').

description.description: Explanation of what this positional argument represents.

type.description: Expected data type of the argument.

options.description: Allowed values (enum choices) for this argument.

default.description: Default value for this positional argument if omitted.

required.description: Whether this positional argument is mandatory.

variadic.description: Whether this argument captures multiple trailing arguments (e.g., args...).

Flag.description: Configuration and help metadata for a CLI flag/option.

aliases.description: List of alternative flag names or short aliases (e.g., ['-v', '--verbose'] or ['v']).

description.description: Detailed explanation of what this flag does.

options.description: Optional list of allowed values (enum choices) for this flag.

default.description: Default value for this flag if not supplied by the user.

required.description: Whether this flag is required when invoking the command.

env.description: Environment variable name that can provide the default value for this flag.

hidden.description: Whether to hide this flag from the help output.

Command.description: Configuration and help metadata for a CLI command or subcommand.

name.description: Name of the command/subcommand (optional when defined as object key).

aliases.description: List of alias names or short forms for this command (e.g., ['i', 'in'] for 'install').

description.description: Detailed description of what this command does.

action.description: Name of the Bash function to invoke when this command is executed (e.g., 'install_archlinux', 'setup_bootloader').

args.description: Positional arguments accepted by this command in order.

options.description: Optional list of allowed values for positional arguments/choices of this command (for single-argument commands).

default.description: Default positional argument value if none is passed by the user.

dev.description: Whether this command is restricted to development mode (requires global '--dev' flag).

root_required.description: Whether this command requires root/sudo privileges to run.

reboot.description: Whether this command requires a system reboot afterwards.

usage.description: Custom usage string for this specific command (e.g., 'archzen setup desktop-profile [profile]').

hidden.description: Whether to hide this command from the general help menu.

CommandEntry.description: A CLI command (Command) or a collection of subcommands (map or list of Command objects).

anyOf.description: Map of subcommands keyed by subcommand name, where each value is a Command.
